tutorial.text: Swipe across a fuse to snip it! You have a limited number of snips, so make each cut count.
Two fuses burn at the same time! Watch both — snip each before the fire reaches the bomb.
This fuse burns FAST! The moment the spark appears, cut it — don't wait.
Sparks start one at a time — watch the delay, snip each fuse as it ignites.
Every fuse passes through the same point. One well-placed cut snips them all!
See that fork in the wick? When the fire reaches it, a NEW wick lights from that point! Snip the first fuse EARLY to stop it — or be ready to cut the new wick.
Some fuses run straight to the bomb — no crossroads to find. Track every wick, not just the crossings.
TWO wicks fork now. Cut a parent EARLY to stop both — or be ready to snip every new wick it lights.
